result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one clear rendering defect stands out: in the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line has overlapping text ('25–35 min' collides with '€0 delivery'), producing garbled, unreadable characters. A secondary cosmetic inconsistency exists in the favorite/heart button styling between cards. Horizontal carousel clipping and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery-time and delivery-fee labels overlap. The text renders as '25–3€0delivery' with 'min' and '€0 delivery' stacked on top of each other, making both values unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so items are laid out sequentially with proper spacing (e.g., a flex row with gap and separator dots, or a single formatted string '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'). Ensure no absolute positioning or negative margins cause the time and fee elements to occupy the same space, and allow wrapping/truncation instead of overlap.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button treatment is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the ramen card shows a bare white heart outline with no background, while the pizza card shows the heart inside a dark translucent circular chip.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim/background container to the heart button on all cards so the icon has consistent contrast and affordance regardless of the underlying image brightness.
